title: Ensure consistent finalization for partial stream retransmits and delayed terminal messages
creator: Anjali Rao
description: Users have reported cases where in-progress websocket/HTTP2 streaming sessions are retried by network proxies or client SDKs and the server receives a late 'terminal' or 'eos' marker for an earlier attempt. This leads to inconsistent final token credits: either double-crediting a partially-finalized response or leaving provisional credits orphaned when a later reconnect finalizes without merging prior partials. The ticket scopes detection and deterministic finalization rules to ensure single lawful credit per logical request across retransmits, truncated reuploads, and delayed terminal messages.
reproduction_steps: 1) Start a streaming generation (ws) with client sequence id X and send tokens; 2) Simulate a transient network partition and client reconnect that retries the tail frames (same logical request id) while server processed some partial output; 3) Reinject a delayed terminal marker (eos) from the original connection after the reconnect finalized; 4) Observe billing ledger: either double-credit or missing correction entries; 5) Variations: large-prefix caching enabled, model-switch failover, and function-call structured outputs attached.
root_cause_analysis: Preliminary: server treats terminal markers as idempotent only when they arrive on the canonical 'session' path. Retries that arrive as a separate ephemeral connection do not always map into the same metering checkpoint. The ledger finalizer accepts the first terminal it sees and marks session complete; delayed terminals are accepted as new finalizers if session state hasn't been atomically anchored. Race between checkpoint anchor and late fragment leads to: a) duplicate finalization path writing final credits twice, or b) finalizer skipping correction when provisional credits from earlier fragments were already reconciled. Additionally, prefix/KV cache warmups cause heuristic length estimations to diverge across attempts, changing token counts on the second attempt.
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce a canonicalization step: every logical request (client_request_id + tenant + route) maps to an immutable ledger anchor id at request start. 2) Require terminal markers to include the anchor id and an ordered-final-seq number; server rejects terminal markers that don't match anchored seq ranges (respond with graceful no-op). 3) Make finalization atomic: use compare-and-swap (CAS) on ledger anchor state to ensure only one finalizer wins and the losing finalizers emit reconciliation deltas (provisional rollback or idempotent confirmation). 4) On reconnect merges, perform a deterministic merge function that reconciles tokenization differences by re-tokenizing the concatenation of accepted input fragments (server-side tokenizer) before producing final credit. 5) Emit visibility events to billing/audit pipeline for any rejected or reconciled terminals. 6) Add a tolerant backfill flow to retroactively fix known orphan provisional credits with admin tool that runs a read-only replay and produces accounting corrections flagged for approval.
acceptance_criteria:
- All existing unit+integration tests for session finalization pass.
- New e2e harness simulating delayed-eos and reconnects shows no double-credit in 1000 randomized trials.
- Billing dashboard alert rate for 'orphan provisional credits' reduces to <0.01% of streaming sessions for 72h canary.
- Audit log contains anchor id for every terminal event and reconciled terminals have reconciliation entries.
- No customer-facing API behavior change; transient rejected terminals are returned with HTTP 200 and a structured no-op event emitted to telemetry.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge server-side anchor+CAB changes behind feature flag 'stream-anchor-v2' on staging.
2) Enable feature for 10% of traffic with ledger reconciliation observability.
3) Monitor for 48h, inspect reconciliations and billing metrics.
4) Ramp to 50% then 100% if metrics stable.
5) Run admin backfill job in read-only dry-run mode for historical sessions older than 24h, validate diffs, then run corrective mode after PM approval.
telemetry_updates:
- Add metric: meter.finalizer.cas_success_count (counter).
- Add metric: meter.terminal_rejected_mismatch (counter) labeled by reason.
- Add histogram: reconciliation.delta_token_count.
- Add alert: orphan_provisional_credit_rate > 0.01% sustained 1h.
- Emit audit event: meter.anchor_assigned (request_id, anchor_id, timestamp).
qa_plan:
- Unit tests: CAS branch coverage and tokenization recompute.
- Integration: synthetic proxy that replays delayed terminals and reconnects.
- E2E: run canary harness capturing ledger snapshots before/after finalization and verify idempotency.
- Load test: run with bursty reconnect scenarios and verify no increase in billed tokens per logical request.
- Post-deploy validation: spot-check invoices for top 50 customers for anomalies for 7 days.
